name: Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai (CMSH)
short_description: A half-marathon event held on November 1, 2026, at Royal Park Rajapruek in Chiang Mai, Thailand, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai (CMSH) is organized by the Scenic Marathon Series and takes place on November 1, 2026, at Royal Park Rajapruek in Chiang Mai, Thailand. The event offers four distance options: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km, catering to a range of runners from casual participants to half-marathon competitors. Registration is currently open for those interested in taking part.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km, 3km) suit different runner levels
Held at Royal Park Rajapruek, a notable venue in Chiang Mai
Registration is currently open, allowing ample time to plan and sign up
research_highlights: Course runs through Royal Park Rajapruek (Royal Flora Ratchaphruek park) on flat, wide paths past the Ho Kham Luang Royal Pavilion, according to the official race description.
The race is one of six half marathons in the Scenic Marathon Series, all measured by an AIMS-accredited measurer and carrying a World Athletics Label, according to the series' official site.
Race falls in early November, which is early dry season in Chiang Mai with cooler, clearer conditions than the hot/rainy months.
As of the search date, no independent participant reviews had been published on major race-listing sites (Ahotu, World's Marathons both list "No reviews yet" for this Chiang Mai edition).
research_watchouts: No first-hand participant race reports or community discussion specific to the Chiang Mai edition were found at the time of this search, so course conditions, crowd support and organisational quality on race day are unverified by runners.
